profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at LiveView Technologies
profile.summary:
I am a very passionate software engineer who greatly enjoys being creative with code. With several years of experience in the Full Stack world, I specialize in both frontend and backend technologies.

In the realm of frontend development, I am well-versed in React.js, having contributed to the development of high-performance and reusable components for web and desktop applications. Similarly, I have extensive experience working with Node.js as I have built multiple scalable cloud APIs in both AWS and Azure using both JavaScript and TypeScript, published multiple NPM packages, and developed a canonical Electron.js application. 

My professional expertise extends beyond React.js and Node.js, encompassing a wide range of technologies, including:
- C#, .NET Framework
- MSSQL
- AWS (Lambda, EC2, DynamoDB, ElastiCache, OpenSearch, S3, CloudFormation, Amplify, Cognito)
- Azure Cloud (Function Apps, Storage Accounts, Automation Accounts, PostreSQL, ARM templates)
- Electron.js
- Angular
- IoT
- RabbitMQ

I recently graduated with a B.S. in Computer Science from UVU in May 2023. During my studies, I undertook two significant projects that showcased my abilities:
- Assembler and VM: Developed in C++, this project involved creating an assembler and virtual machine, demonstrating my proficiency in low-level programming and system architecture.
- Compiler: Implemented in TypeScript and Node.js, this project allowed me to delve into the intricacies of compiler design and language processing.

Beyond my academic ventures, I maintain an active presence on GitHub. Notable personal projects include:
- A chess engine in C#, leveraging bitboards for efficient piece placement and move calculation.
- A MIDI library in C# that facilitated the generation of a massive 1.2 terabyte MIDI file.
- A performant and cross-platform duplicate file finder, developed in Rust.
- Various NPM packages.

As a software engineer, I thrive in collaborative environments and derive satisfaction from helping others. I bring both capability and creativity to my work, and I'm always eager to tackle new challenges.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: American Fork, Utah, United States · On-site
positions.description:
* Led migration of a camera control interface from MQTT to a Go-based ONVIF API, improving interoperability and maintainability.
* One of the primary contributors to a Zephyr-based embedded firmware: implemented drivers across I2C, SPI, UART; performed memory optimizations; and applied embedded C/C++ best practices.
* Contributed to system features such as Hawkbit OTA updates and integration of Trusted Firmware-M (TF-M) for STM32 platforms.
* Built strong expertise in embedded tooling and workflows, including CMake, SEGGER and ST ecosystems, and low-level debugging (JTAG, SWD, instruction tracing).
* Designed and implemented a Python-based code generation tool to produce API stubs from Protocol Buffers for Python, TypeScript, and Go.
* Continually emphasizing scalable architecture and maintainable design across all systems and components.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: American Fork, Utah, United States · Hybrid

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer
positions.description:
- Contributed to both the frontend and backend development of a sophisticated full-stack family history web application. 
- Became fluent in Microsoft Orleans, Azure CosmosDB, Azure Event Hubs, Azure App Services, and the Gremlin Query Language for querying a graph database.
- Used my extensive knowledge of C# and .NET to contribute greatly to the backend piece of the application.
- Became fluent in Next.js and utilized my fluency in TypeScript and React to greatly contribute to the frontend piece of the application.
- As of 7/22/2024, my net line-of-code contribution count with this company is hovering around -30,000 (negative thirty-thousand).
positions.insights: Skills: Node.js · Microsoft Orleans · C# · Azure Cosmos DB · React.js · TypeScript

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
- Contributed to the maintenance and development of the company's desktop product used by over 1000 customers by greatly increasing my skills with C#, .NET Framework, NHibernate, NUnit, WinForms, and MSSQL.
- Introduced a plan for eliminating all technical debt present in the company's browser-based product, which included moving things to the Azure cloud and migrating the entire codebase to a single-page React app (SPA).
- Became familiar with Docker and fluent in WSL to help contribute to the technical debt elimination process, described just above.
- Developed a canonical Electron app with React as the frontend as a drop-in replacement for a very widely used (albeit a bit buggy and slow), in-house company utility to help increase company productivity.
- Pioneered the beginning of a long-term migration of company APIs to Azure Serverless Functions.
- Became very familiar with Azure Cloud services, APIs, PostgreSQL, and ARM templates as part of the Azure Serverless Function migration.
- Developed an open-source C# library for obtaining user-input via terminal as part of another in-house company utility which helps to increase company productivity.
positions.insights: Skills: RabbitMQ · .NET Framework · C# · Docker · React.js · WSL · Microsoft SQL Server · PostgreSQL · Electron · Microsoft Azure

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.locationName: Salt Lake City, Utah, United States
positions.description:
• Became fluent with Node.js, JavaScript, TypeScript, and their accompanying tools such as NPM and NPX.
• Contributed to AWS backend development by becoming familiar with various AWS services such as DynamoDB, Redis via ElastiCache, OpenSearch, Lambda, API Gateway, CloudWatch, Cognito, and various others.
• Connected frontend and backend services by learning AWS Amplify and CloudFormation templates.
• Greatly contributed to frontend development by becoming very fluent in React and by becoming very familiar with Angular, Babel, and Webpack.
positions.insights: Skills: Internet of Things (IoT) · C# · React.js · Angular · AWS Lambda · Amazon Dynamodb · Amazon ElastiCache · Amazon S3 · AWS CloudFormation

positions.title: IT Help Desk Agent/Project Manager
positions.description:
•	Ensured constant company production by thoroughly managing the systems of over 4000 employees.
•	Personally oversaw the speedy performance of production by competently managing and maintaining Active Directory and several in-house servers. 
•	Employed communication skills to troubleshoot issues and ensure user satisfaction to maintain the high quality of production.
•	Greatly reduced production overhead by overseeing and directing the deployment of an upgraded software package to 15 users.

positions.title: Account Creations and Services Specialist
positions.description:
•	Greatly contributed to positive company reviews by employing very competent communication skills to ensure customer satisfaction on the phone.
•	Ensured competent company throughput and efficiency by becoming fluent with a company specific edition of Salesforce. 
•	Demonstrated diligence and integrity by taking ownership of customer calls and seeing them through to full resolution.

positions.title: Laborer and IT Manager/Freelance Developer
positions.description:
•	Considerably simplified and improved a vital company process by developing alone a customized and sophisticated piece of software. 
•	Guaranteed high company throughput and reduced overhead by managing all company systems and file servers.
•	Always worked very hard by caring for and properly using a CNC Engraving Machine to produce a very popular company product.

projects.title: ImageMaster GUI
projects.description:
The program is mainly used to parse orders and tile images on special sheets of paper which are later printed and turn into keychains. Functionality of this program also include the creation and manipulation of these tiles, the automation of the detection and extensions of the different types of incoming orders, and the substantial simplification of complete management of nearly everything that the company prints and sells.

It was written entirely in C# and the .NET Framework with the use of an external PDF creation library.

testScores.name: AP Calculus AB/BC
testScores.description: The first and second year AP calculus test. Scored the highest score possible. Immensely enjoyed the course.
